citations.claim: body centre jumped from left face of thin wall to far right of it between consecutive steps, i.e. tunneled through
body was at left face of wall one step before, showing the crossing occurred between steps 4 and 5
body approached wall at full speed one step earlier with no deflection

explanation: Fast body at 60 m/s with max dt=1/30 moves ~2.0 per step past a 0.1-thick wall at x=10. Collision handling fails to stop/deflect it: step 4 leaves centre on the wall face with 0.5 overlap, then step 5 jumps to x~12 across the wall. Per-step displacement >> wall thickness with only discrete impulse+correction lets the body embed then pass through.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 4 and 5

vision_note: The red body travels from the left toward the thin vertical wall and is touching it in step 4. In step 5 it appears on the right side of the wall and continues onward, having crossed through instead of bouncing.
